title: Our Sun Came Late to the Milky Way’s Star-Birth Party
description: Caption: Artist's view of night sky from a hypothetical planet within a young Milky Way-like galaxy 10 billion years ago, the sky are ablaze with star birth. Pink clouds of gas harbor newborn stars, and bluish-white, young star clusters litter the landscape.  Image Credit: NASA/ESA/Z. Levay (STScI)
